claim_ceiling: Provisional target profile only. No latency, scale, revocation, privacy, Holochain runtime or superiority result is measured or established.

workload_profiles.purpose: Basic multi-agent correctness and smoke performance
Group churn, cache behaviour and cursor recovery
Real-conductor scale, partition and revocation qualification
Capacity and failure-domain study; not an initial release gate

metrics.metric: Warm local PEP decision latency excluding external authentication and MFA
Warm local PEP decision latency excluding external authentication and MFA
Pure frontier comparison latency with up to 64 authority components
Pure offline lease precondition evaluation, including exact scope, epoch, digest, frontier and clock-profile checks
Agreement with an independently authored decision oracle on frozen and held-out fixtures
False ALLOW decisions across frozen and held-out adversarial cases
Prohibited private-attribute disclosures through public DHT payloads, links, indexes, logs, telemetry or receipts
High-risk or write operations admitted after required freshness or lease expiry
Same-sequence fork or unproven descendant incorrectly classified as sufficiently fresh
Partial group expansion results returned after cycle or depth/node/edge budget failure
Effective revocation time to last accepted protected effect across all observed PEP/session/token/worker surfaces
Effective revocation time to last accepted protected effect across all observed PEP/session/token/worker surfaces
Group expansion latency and allocations by node count, edge count, depth and branching factor
SCIM deprovision event to last accepted session/token/worker/PEP effect
Conductor restart to first successful zome call for the first and last app/cell
Partition heal to verified convergence of the exact required authority operation set

fault_schedules: Two-way partition with independently authored authority updates and revocations
Large divergent DHT op sets bracketing the upstream reported gossip boundary
Revoked single-function and multi-function host capability grants
Lair inventories around 1, 40, 41, 100 and 120 keys with existing-agent-key install
Conductor restart and idle operation around 10k, 20k and 100k DHT ops
Clock uncertainty that straddles not-before and expiry boundaries
Concurrent incomparable realm and issuer authority frontiers
Group cycles, alternate long paths, and node/edge/depth budget exhaustion
SCIM duplicate, delayed, replayed and out-of-order deprovision/security events

comparators.name: SpiceDB
comparators.scope: Relationship authorization and per-request at_least_as_fresh / fully_consistent behaviour
comparators.consistency_profile: Use ZedToken at_least_as_fresh for matched read-after-write; separately report fully_consistent cache-bypass results

comparators.name: OpenFGA
comparators.consistency_profile: Compare matched HIGHER_CONSISTENCY and MINIMIZE_LATENCY query modes

comparators.name: Cedar
comparators.consistency_profile: Same policy/request semantics and context; do not compare unmatched policy expressiveness

comparators.name: OPA
comparators.consistency_profile: Same input corpus, policy distribution and cache conditions

comparators.name: AD DS / Entra ID / FreeIPA
comparators.scope: End-to-end enterprise lifecycle and incumbent integration
comparators.consistency_profile: Compare only equivalent service surfaces; report identity, session, group, recovery and administration paths separately

comparators.name: SPIRE / SPIFFE
comparators.scope: Workload identity issuance, rotation and trust-domain federation
comparators.consistency_profile: Compare shared workload identity responsibilities only

comparators.name: Holochain
comparators.consistency_profile: Exact conductor/HDK/HDI/Lair/Kitsune2 tuple and real conductors; report simulated peers separately
